title: Peacock holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M72 35 Q70 50 65 62' fill='none' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='26' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='26' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff6688' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='22' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff99aa' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='72,39 76,39 74,43' fill='#cc2244'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='39' r='1.8' fill='#cc2244'/>

  <!-- Peacock body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#2266aa'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='11' ry='15' fill='#2e7fc2'/>

  <!-- Tail feathers fanning up behind -->
  <g>
    <!-- Outer feathers -->
    <path d='M45 68 Q22 40 12 18 Q18 22 26 24 Q30 28 34 32 Q36 38 40 44 Q42 50 45 58' fill='#118844'/>
    <path d='M45 68 Q30 32 22 8 Q28 14 34 18 Q38 24 42 30 Q44 38 45 48' fill='#22aa55'/>
    <path d='M45 68 Q40 28 38 4 Q42 12 46 16 Q48 24 48 32 Q47 44 45 56' fill='#33cc66'/>
    <path d='M45 68 Q50 28 52 4 Q54 12 56 16 Q56 24 54 32 Q50 44 47 56' fill='#33cc66'/>
    <path d='M45 68 Q58 32 66 8 Q66 14 64 18 Q60 24 56 32 Q52 42 48 54' fill='#22aa55'/>
    <path d='M45 68 Q68 40 78 18 Q78 24 72 28 Q68 34 62 40 Q56 48 50 58' fill='#118844'/>
    <!-- Feather eyes -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='22' r='5' fill='#ffdd22'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#ff8800'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='22' r='1' fill='#cc4400'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='12' r='5' fill='#ffdd22'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#ff8800'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='12' r='1' fill='#cc4400'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='5' fill='#ffdd22'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#ff8800'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='1' fill='#cc4400'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='14' r='5' fill='#ffdd22'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='14' r='2.5' fill='#ff8800'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='14' r='1' fill='#cc4400'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='24' r='4.5' fill='#ffdd22'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='24' r='2.2' fill='#ff8800'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='24' r='0.9' fill='#cc4400'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M45 58 Q44 50 43 44 Q42 38 42 34' fill='none' stroke='#2266aa' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M45 58 Q44 50 43 44 Q42 38 42 34' fill='none' stroke='#3399dd' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='28' r='9' fill='#2266aa'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='28' r='7.5' fill='#3399dd'/>

  <!-- Crest feathers -->
  <line x1='40' y1='19' x2='38' y2='10' stroke='#33cc66' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='9' r='2' fill='#ffdd22'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='19' x2='43' y2='8' stroke='#33cc66' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='7' r='2' fill='#ffdd22'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='19' x2='48' y2='10' stroke='#33cc66' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='9' r='2' fill='#ffdd22'/>

  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points='34,28 27,30 34,32' fill='#ffaa22'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='30' x2='29' y2='31' stroke='#cc7711' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='26' r='1.3' fill='#111133'/>
  <circle cx='37.2' cy='25.4' r='0.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Wing holding string -->
  <path d='M55 60 Q62 58 65 62 Q60 65 55 64 Z' fill='#2e7fc2'/>
  <!-- Hand/wing tip gripping string -->
  <circle cx='65' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#2e7fc2'/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1='40' y1='89' x2='38' y2='96' stroke='#ffaa22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='89' x2='52' y2='96' stroke='#ffaa22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d='M35 96 L38 96 L41 96' fill='none' stroke='#ffaa22' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M49 96 L52 96 L55 96' fill='none' stroke='#ffaa22' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
